claim_checks.claim: China VBP repricing impact (record bear point)
claim_checks.finding: FY2025: Q4 APAC organic -12.8% 'primarily reflecting a slower patient flow in China due to the delayed volume-based procurement (VBP 2.0) process as well as destocking of the distributors'. Q3-26 call: China returned to growth in Q3; VBP 2.0 tender prices expected to be implemented in Q1 2027; management sees the VBP 2.0 price effect at 'maximum five to 15% down' because private-sector implant case prices (RMB4,000-4,500) are already below the VBP 1.0 benchmark (RMB7,500). Evidence: FACT (statements) / TARGET (management expectation).

claim_checks.claim: Organic growth 2024 13.7%, 2025 8.9%, 9M-2026 8.3%; geography EMEA 41.6 / NA 26.4 / APAC 23.0 / LatAm 9.0
claim_checks.finding: All confirmed against the FY2025 release and Q3-26 call. FY2024 constant-currency growth (15.0%) exceeded organic (13.7%) because of acquisitions.
Original Feb-2026 outlook was +30-60bp at constant 2025 FX; raised (per record S2, June 2026) and confirmed on the Q3-26 call at around 140-170bp.
